text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While things are heating up between Triple Crown champion Narita Brian and the "Queen of the Amazons" Hishi Amazon…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun determinedly heads to the track with no intention of losing to either of them.
